maguindanao/set-1/a-vow-carried-by-the-w.skill: Action — search your deck for a Level 1 Maguindanaon unit and special call it. It enters charged. At the end of your turn, Offer that unit if it remains in an Ally Zone.

maguindanao/set-1/a-vow-carried-by-the-w.pattern: D Phantom Blaster support creates expendable bodies; Revenger temporary calls
maguindanao/set-1/a-vow-carried-by-the-w.balance: Preserve the printed non-currency costs, timing, targets and once-per-turn limits.

maguindanao/set-1/kabalalan-shook-from-b.skill: Action — [Cost: Offer 1 of your Allies] exhaust up to two of your opponent's Allies. If Garahana is released, you may damage one of those Allies that was already exhausted before this Action resolved.
maguindanao/set-1/kabalalan-shook-from-b.gameplay: Sets up attacks and exhausted-target removal. Garahana upgrades it only when the opponent already committed a unit, which limits blowouts.
maguindanao/set-1/kabalalan-shook-from-b.pattern: Shadow Paladin sacrifice-for-removal; controlled D-era board pressure
maguindanao/set-1/kabalalan-shook-from-b.balance: The damaged target must have been exhausted before resolution; otherwise this becomes two removals for one card.

maguindanao/set-1/until-tarabusaw-tired.skill: Action — choose one Beast Ally. The first time it finishes an attack this turn, you may Offer one of your other Allies. If you do, charge the chosen Beast and it gets Power +3000 until end of turn.
maguindanao/set-1/until-tarabusaw-tired.gameplay: Lets any Beast borrow Tarabuk's attack pattern for one turn. The player must still supply a separate Offer body.
maguindanao/set-1/until-tarabusaw-tired.pattern: Tachikaze retirement as the price for another attack
maguindanao/set-1/until-tarabusaw-tired.balance: Ally only; no Persona restand. The granted trigger is once for the turn.

maguindanao/set-1/the-price-of-the-third.skill: Action — play only if you Offered 3 or more this turn. Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card. If Garahana is released, your Persona gets Power +3000 until end of turn.
maguindanao/set-1/the-price-of-the-third.gameplay: Use the skill above. Normal calls and Actions use one play; skills and special calls do not.
maguindanao/set-1/the-price-of-the-third.balance: Check the threshold after Offer value is counted. It cannot be played before the third Offer is paid.

maguindanao/set-1/day-became-night.skill: Action — exhaust up to two of your opponent's Allies. If you Offered 3 or more this turn, damage one exhausted opponent Ally instead of exhausting the second unit.
maguindanao/set-1/day-became-night.gameplay: Opens targets for Scourge attacks. A heavy Offer turn upgrades one of the exhausts into removal.
maguindanao/set-1/day-became-night.pattern: Shadow Paladin turns sacrifice into board control
maguindanao/set-1/day-became-night.balance: Resolve either two exhausts or one exhaust plus one damage. Do not damage two units.

maguindanao/set-1/when-the-life-sign-wit.skill: Action — [Cost: Offer 1 of your Allies] your opponent chooses one of their Allies and damages it. If your opponent has no Allies, draw 1 card instead.
maguindanao/set-1/when-the-life-sign-wit.gameplay: Trades your chosen Last Oath unit for the opponent's least valuable Ally. If there is no target, it converts the Offer into hand replacement.
maguindanao/set-1/when-the-life-sign-wit.balance: Preserve the printed non-currency costs, timing, targets and once-per-turn limits.

maguindanao/set-1/the-brother-awakened.skill: Action — search your deck and Grave for up to one Rinamuntaw and up to one Rinayung, then special call them to separate Ally Zones. They enter charged. At the end of your turn, Offer each one that remains in an Ally Zone.
maguindanao/set-1/the-brother-awakened.gameplay: Builds two named Level 1 bodies for an attack or a large Offer cost, then guarantees their Last Oaths if they survive.
maguindanao/set-1/the-brother-awakened.pattern: Shadow Paladin named-piece assembly; Revenger temporary calls
maguindanao/set-1/the-brother-awakened.balance: One copy of each name only. Require two open or replaceable Ally Zones.

maguindanao/set-1/seven-heads-before-one.skill: Action — choose your Persona. Until end of turn, when it attacks, it gets Power +1000 for each unit card in your Grave, up to +10000. If seven or more of those cards are Maguindanaon units, damage one exhausted opponent Ally after that attack.
maguindanao/set-1/seven-heads-before-one.gameplay: Turns the filled Grave into a final attack bonus without consuming more Allies. A deeply developed Garahana line also receives one controlled removal.
maguindanao/set-1/seven-heads-before-one.pattern: Ritual-style grave threshold; late Shadow Paladin scaling
maguindanao/set-1/seven-heads-before-one.balance: Cap the Power at +10000 and removal at once per turn through the granted effect.

maguindanao/set-1/the-lowlands-rose-agai.skill: Action — choose up to two Level 1 Maguindanaon units in your Grave. Put one into your hand and put the other on the bottom of your deck. If you chose only one, put it into your hand.
maguindanao/set-1/the-lowlands-rose-agai.gameplay: Recovers one tool and returns another to the deck for future searches. Because it removes cards from the Grave, playing it can turn off Garahana and creates a real timing decision.
maguindanao/set-1/the-lowlands-rose-agai.partners: Potri Rainalaut, Old Woman, Restored Magindanao
maguindanao/set-1/the-lowlands-rose-agai.pattern: Luard recycles low grades from drop; resource loop with a threshold cost
maguindanao/set-1/the-lowlands-rose-agai.balance: Make the Garahana re-check immediate after cards leave the Grave.

maguindanao/set-1/spring-veiled-heiress-.skill: [green][Last Oath]: When this unit is Offered, choose one of your Allies. It gets Power +3000 until end of turn. Then, once per turn per copy, you may choose one of your opponent's Ally units and damage it.
maguindanao/set-1/spring-veiled-heiress-.gameplay: [Last Oath]: When this unit is Offered, choose one of your Allies. It gets Power +3000 until end of turn. Then you may choose one of your opponent's Ally units and damage it.
maguindanao/set-1/spring-veiled-heiress-.partners: Potri Rainalaut, Kabalalan Shook From Below, Pah
maguindanao/set-1/spring-veiled-heiress-.pattern: Tachikaze retirement refund; Last Oath as resource conversion
maguindanao/set-1/spring-veiled-heiress-.balance: Preserve the printed non-currency costs, timing, targets and once-per-turn limits.

maguindanao/set-1/seven-sight-final-scou.skill:
[green][Persona] 1/turn: When this unit attacks, [Cost: Offer 2 of your other Allies] look at the top 7 cards of your deck. Special call up to two Beasts or Birds from among them. Put the remaining cards on the bottom in any order.
[green][Garahana][Persona] 1/turn: After this unit attacks, [Cost: Offer 3] choose a Seven-Sight Final Scourge, Gurayn from your hand and Personify into it, charged.
maguindanao/set-1/seven-sight-final-scou.gameplay: Look seven deep for up to two Beast or Bird attackers. After battle, Offer 3 to Personify a fresh Gurayn from hand; the outgoing Persona moves to Heart.
maguindanao/set-1/seven-sight-final-scou.partners: Pahira, Four Scourges Came, Mountain Tunung
maguindanao/set-1/seven-sight-final-scou.pattern: Tachikaze attack-chain replacement; D-era support finds exact archetype pieces
maguindanao/set-1/seven-sight-final-scou.balance: Preserve the printed non-currency costs, timing, targets and once-per-turn limits.

maguindanao/set-1/keeper-of-the-last-ref.skill: [green][Last Oath]: When this unit is Offered, choose one of your Allies. It gets Power +3000 until end of turn. Then, once per turn across all cards with this name, you may search your deck for another Keeper of the Last Refuge, Datu Karim and special call it, charged.
maguindanao/set-1/keeper-of-the-last-ref.gameplay: [Last Oath]: When this unit is Offered, choose one of your Allies. It gets Power +3000 until end of turn. Then you may search your deck for another Keeper of the Last Refuge, Datu Karim and special call it, charged.
maguindanao/set-1/keeper-of-the-last-ref.pattern: Tachikaze hand recovery after retirement; Luard low-grade recursion
maguindanao/set-1/keeper-of-the-last-ref.balance: Preserve the printed non-currency costs, timing, targets and once-per-turn limits.

maguindanao/set-1/city-beyond-the-sunset.skill:
Auto-switch — before you draw, you may switch to this Codex for free.
State — Garahana: released while your Grave contains 5 or more Maguindanaon unit cards.
Codex skill — Instead of drawing, Offer 1 Ally or send the top card of your deck to your Grave. Then, if Garahana is released, draw 1 card.
maguindanao/set-1/city-beyond-the-sunset.gameplay: Makes the first small sacrifice each turn improve the hand and place another useful card in the Grave.
maguindanao/set-1/city-beyond-the-sunset.pattern: Retirement replacement value; Luard grave shaping
maguindanao/set-1/city-beyond-the-sunset.balance: One trigger per turn. It filters rather than drawing a clean extra card.

maguindanao/set-1/forest-of-broken-branc.skill:
Auto-switch — at the start of your Main Phase, you may switch to this Codex for free.
State — Garahana: released while your Grave contains 5 or more Maguindanaon unit cards.
1/Turn: Codex skill — At the start of your Main Phase, send the top card of your deck to your Grave. If it was a Unit, one of your Units gets Power +5000 until end of turn.
maguindanao/set-1/forest-of-broken-branc.gameplay: Transforms one battle-phase sacrifice into a fresh attacker. It is the closest Set 1 expression of Tachikaze's retire-and-return turns.
maguindanao/set-1/forest-of-broken-branc.balance: Preserve the printed non-currency costs, timing, targets and once-per-turn limits.

maguindanao/set-1/throne-of-the-sun-shad.skill:
Auto-switch — when your Persona attacks, you may switch to this Codex for free.
State — Garahana: released while your Grave contains 5 or more Maguindanaon unit cards.
1/Turn: Codex skill — When your Persona attacks, it gets Power +3000 for each card Offered this turn, until end of turn.
maguindanao/set-1/throne-of-the-sun-shad.gameplay: Rewards the deck's main cost with a simple, visible Persona payoff. It is the best default Codex for Pah and Sulayman finishers.
maguindanao/set-1/throne-of-the-sun-shad.partners: Pah, Sulayman, Price of the Third Victory
maguindanao/set-1/throne-of-the-sun-shad.pattern: Phantom Blaster converts sacrifice count into boss Power
maguindanao/set-1/throne-of-the-sun-shad.balance: One attack receives the appropriate bonus each time; restanding Personas also receive it, so test Pah carefully.

maguindanao/set-1/the-rattan-haunt-mount.skill:
Auto-switch — before you draw, if you have 2 or fewer Barriers, you may switch to this Codex for free.
State — Garahana: released while your Grave contains 5 or more Maguindanaon unit cards.
1/Turn: Codex skill — When you Offer a Unit during your turn, search your deck for a Unit other than the one you Offered and special call it.
maguindanao/set-1/the-rattan-haunt-mount.gameplay: Lets an activated Offer cost keep its body for a later turn while denying an immediate attack. Last Oath still resolves before the return.
maguindanao/set-1/the-rattan-haunt-mount.pattern: Tachikaze units survive retirement; existing Liguasan Marsh pattern
maguindanao/set-1/the-rattan-haunt-mount.balance: Return exhausted and only once per turn to prevent free attack loops.

maguindanao/set-1/peak-of-seven-sights-m.skill:
Auto-switch — before you Personify, you may switch to this Codex for free.
State — Garahana: released while your Grave contains 5 or more Maguindanaon unit cards.
Codex skill — Instead of Personifying from your hand, look at the top 5 cards of your deck and Personify one Level 3 Unit among them. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck.
maguindanao/set-1/peak-of-seven-sights-m.gameplay: Turns an expendable Ally into a Persona or large attacker while feeding Offer and Last Oath synergies.
maguindanao/set-1/peak-of-seven-sights-m.pattern: Shadow Paladin boss searchers; sacrifice as a consistency cost
maguindanao/set-1/peak-of-seven-sights-m.balance: Level 3 and subtype restrictions keep the search narrow. The skill consumes the turn's Codex action use.

maguindanao/set-1/mirror-of-the-giant-wa.skill:
Auto-switch — before you draw, if your opponent has more Barriers than you, you may switch to this Codex for free.
State — Garahana: released while your Grave contains 5 or more Maguindanaon unit cards.
1/Turn: Codex skill — When your State is released, all of your Units get Power +1000 until end of turn.
maguindanao/set-1/mirror-of-the-giant-wa.gameplay: Rebuilds an expendable body after taking damage and can put a discarded Maguindanaon card into the Grave at the same time.
maguindanao/set-1/mirror-of-the-giant-wa.pattern: Shadow Paladin continually creates sacrifice material; existing Lake Buluan pattern
maguindanao/set-1/mirror-of-the-giant-wa.balance: No trigger on a Force Barrier check. The discard is mandatory before the deck search.

maguindanao/set-1/reach-of-the-ridge-gia.skill:
Auto-switch — before you draw, if your opponent has more Units than you, you may switch to this Codex for free.
State — Garahana: released while your Grave contains 5 or more Maguindanaon unit cards.
1/Turn: Codex skill — Before paying an Offer cost, if you have not Offered a Unit this turn, you may activate this skill in its own response chain. After it resolves, the first Unit you Offer this turn counts as 2 Offers, regardless of subtype.
maguindanao/set-1/reach-of-the-ridge-gia.gameplay: Activate before paying an Offer cost. After the separate chain resolves, one Unit can pay Offer 2; two ordinary Units can pay Offer 3.
maguindanao/set-1/reach-of-the-ridge-gia.pattern: Pre-payment chain followed by a once-per-turn Offer bonus
maguindanao/set-1/reach-of-the-ridge-gia.balance: Only the first physical Unit Offered counts as 2. Does not create a second Last Oath or change Grave cards or subtypes.

maguindanao/set-1/cave-beneath-the-earth.skill:
Auto-switch — when your Barrier breaks during your opponent's turn, you may switch to this Codex for free.
State — Garahana: released while your Grave contains 5 or more Maguindanaon unit cards.
1/Turn: Codex skill — When your Barrier breaks, your Persona gets Power +1000 for each of your broken Barriers, until end of turn.
maguindanao/set-1/cave-beneath-the-earth.gameplay: Redirects a removal effect into a chosen Last Oath unit. The threatened Ally survives, but the player still loses a body.
maguindanao/set-1/cave-beneath-the-earth.pattern: Shadow Paladin sacrifice as protection; Tachikaze death-trigger selection
maguindanao/set-1/cave-beneath-the-earth.balance: It does not prevent battle damage and cannot Offer the threatened unit itself.

maguindanao/set-1/the-sea-withdrawn-lowl.skill:
Auto-switch — when your Persona is under attack, you may switch to this Codex for free.
State — Garahana: released while your Grave contains 5 or more Maguindanaon unit cards.
1/Turn: Codex skill — When you check a Barrier and it is not a Force, special call 1 Unit from your deck, then discard 1 card.
maguindanao/set-1/the-sea-withdrawn-lowl.gameplay: Recycles a spent unit into the deck and converts a Level 1 in hand into immediate board presence. Removing a Grave card can temporarily clear Garahana.
maguindanao/set-1/the-sea-withdrawn-lowl.partners: Old Woman, Indarapatra, Lowlands Rose Again
maguindanao/set-1/the-sea-withdrawn-lowl.pattern: Luard recycles low grades; repeated fodder without infinite Grave growth
maguindanao/set-1/the-sea-withdrawn-lowl.balance: The Grave payment must occur first. Re-evaluate Garahana immediately after it leaves the Grave.

maguindanao/set-1/shore-of-the-broken-hi.skill:
Auto-switch — before you draw, if your opponent has more cards in hand than you, you may switch to this Codex for free.
State — Garahana: released while your Grave contains 5 or more Maguindanaon unit cards.
1/Turn: Codex skill — When this Codex becomes active, draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
maguindanao/set-1/shore-of-the-broken-hi.gameplay: Adds a small recovery reward to Force-check turns and gives Tomitay a Codex that does not create another attack by itself.
maguindanao/set-1/shore-of-the-broken-hi.partners: Tomitay, all Tunung Forces, Lanao Sprite
maguindanao/set-1/shore-of-the-broken-hi.pattern: Tachikaze trigger-driven resource gain; D-era support centered on the leader's check
maguindanao/set-1/shore-of-the-broken-hi.balance: Once per turn regardless of how many Forces resolve. Return Level 1 only.
